verdict.rationale: ByteAsk runs locally as a terminal agent, and its 'self-hosted models' page says you can bring any OpenAI-compatible model and drive it like a built-in cloud model, so inference can be self-hosted. However, the product relies on magic-link account sign-in, plan and usage windows, and a cloud 'auto' model chain, so the core service is not shown to be self-hostable. Missing for 10: evidence of running without the vendor account/backend, source availability or an on-prem deployment option, and independent or hands-on confirmation of fully self-hosted operation.
